title: Find Minimum Operations to Make All Elements Divisible by Three
summary: Given an integer array nums, determine the least number of operations needed to make each element divisible by 3.
statement: Given an integer array nums, determine the least number of operations needed to make each element divisible by 3. An operation consists of adding or subtracting 1 from any element in the array.
constraints: One operation increments or decrements one array value by one.
Make every value divisible by three using the fewest operations.
Return the total number of operations.
reference_solution:
def operations_to_multiples_of_three(nums):
    return sum(value%3!=0 for value in nums)
hints: A remainder zero costs no operation.
Remainders one and two each cost exactly one by decrementing or incrementing.
Therefore count values whose remainder modulo three is nonzero.
Operations on separate values do not interact, so summing their individual minima is globally minimal.
editorial: Operations on separate values do not interact, so summing their individual minima is globally minimal.

tests.explanation: One, two, and four each need one move; three needs none, totaling three.
Every value is already divisible, so zero operations are needed.
